decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood authorized corrective revisions until the first formal Release succeeds in response to the disclosed .4 scope and unchanged 42 residual Action advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low), retaining the 2026-10-15 UTC deadline. This fresh record binds only v9.0.2-motrix.5 to its exact source lock, every workflow byte, supporting assessment, complete same-day audit report and official full-SHA Action references. Formal .4 run 36840700978 passed six candidate builds, four independent rebuilds, all six secret-free approvals and final grants, then failed closed in both Windows packaging entrypoints because isolated Python could not import the adjacent pipeline_lib helper. Risk rechecks and exact input/grant validations passed. It was cancelled while macOS awaited approval; no signing credential or Release was reached. All four earlier annotated tags remain immutable and their scope records are not reused. The .5 correction anchors packaging helper imports to the protected recipe directory, executes real native Python CLI entrypoints under isolation, and runs the exact final real-payload packaging command in required native Windows CI and before native pre-sign approval upload. Tests bind the three command copies, preventing surrogate-only validation and drift. Reused diagnostic packages cannot satisfy these fresh required packaging checks. No module search path points into downloaded payloads. Existing risk validation, binary-mode protected readers, deterministic macOS ad-hoc baseline and read-only bounded NASM evidence remain unchanged. BUILD_REVISION changes, but source archives/URLs, toolchains, official Action commits and all inventoried advisories are unchanged. Audit 36807648066 remains the same-day complete inventory; no vulnerability is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction risks before validation and signature type-binding risk. Publication remains conditional on all required exact-commit CI checks, file/race/size/hash guards, independent clean rebuilds, Developer ID signing/notarization, Ed25519 authentication, independent final verification, Immutable Releases and protected-Environment confirmations. Further corrective revisions require fresh exact-scope records. New advisories, expiry extensions or unrelated source/Action updates require a new human decision. This limited record grants no Environment approval, no exception for another tag or unrecorded changed scope, and no publication after the deadline.
